success_definition: Exact support AND worst true coefficient relative error <= 10% AND mean of all three final forecast relative L2 errors <= 5%.
budget_definition: 3 initial training + 2 development + acquired experiments; failed acquisitions are charged. Final test measurements are separate.
noise_definition: 1% = sigma 0.004; 3% = sigma 0.012, both relative to fixed initial-field RMS 0.4, not each trajectory RMS.
uncertainty_note: Bootstrap inclusion frequencies are uncalibrated descriptive stability, not probabilities of true terms. A singleton candidate set does not prove identification.

primary_metric.definition: Mean over all planned parameter tasks of each task maximum relative error among true PDE coefficients. No pooling with 3% stress.

design_note: Both rich_then_variance and rich_then_information use the same fixed rich first query; subsequent relative A-optimal scores are approximate design proxies, not Fisher or information-gain guarantees.
cost_comparison_note: Post-hoc readout at saved budget checkpoints, not truth-based online stopping; null means no complete same-quality comparison. Negative savings mean higher cost.

details.endpoint: mean of each task maximum true-term relative coefficient error

coefficient_endpoint.endpoint: mean of each task maximum true-term relative coefficient error

Each policy worst overall final-budget row and worst complete prediction row are audited, with duplicate rows removed and at most 36 forecast slots. Missing models or sources retain explicit failure checks; successful numerical coverage is reported separately and may be unavailable.
The 36 noise conditions share eighteen parameter tasks and 54 clean final trajectories; policy/condition forecasts are paired, not independent samples.
This is controlled synthetic validation with an observed prefix and full 1.0 future horizon, not physical measurements or calibrated posterior probabilities.
Synthetic controlled periodic scalar PDEs; no new real-world validation.
36 paired noise conditions represent 18 parameter tasks, not 36 independent physical systems.
Only initial-condition choice is optimized; costs are equal and sensors/boundaries are fixed.
Balanced Brier scores are descriptive and do not establish posterior calibration.
This experiment does not resolve the previous KS benchmark 5% failure.
